beats.en: Day three of the blackout. The line outside the store
beats.prompt: Wide shot: an extremely long queue of simple stick-figure people snaking along the sidewalk in front of a dark supermarket with lights off, grey daytime sky, Korean apartment towers in the background

beats.en: went on forever.
beats.prompt: View from the back of the queue: rows of stick-figure backs stretching to a tiny supermarket far away, strong perspective, the line disappears into the distance

beats.en: Minsu, at the very back.
beats.prompt: Minsu standing alone at the very end of the queue, slumped shoulders, tired face, holding an empty reusable shopping bag

beats.en: And at the very front... the lady next door.
beats.prompt: The grandma neighbor standing first in line right at the supermarket door, calm and smug, cane in one hand, small wave

beats.ko: 지난 화 투표대로, 민수는 엄마에게 전화했어요.
beats.en: Just like you voted, Minsu called his mom.
beats.prompt: Flashback at night in a dark apartment: Minsu sitting on the floor talking on his phone, relieved smile, phone screen glow on his face

beats.en: Now his battery is at 3%.
beats.prompt: Close-up of Minsu's hand holding a phone, the screen shows a nearly empty red battery icon (no numbers), Minsu sweating in the background

beats.ko: 지난 화 투표대로, 민수는 손전등으로 밤을 버텼어요.
beats.en: Just like you voted, Minsu used his phone as a flashlight.
beats.prompt: Flashback at night in a dark apartment: Minsu holding up his phone's flashlight beam, nervous, shadows on the wall

beats.ko: 그런데 엄마 부재중 전화가 스무 통.
beats.en: But he has twenty missed calls from Mom.
beats.prompt: Close-up of Minsu's phone screen covered in a long stack of missed-call notifications (blank bars, no readable text), Minsu's guilty face behind it

beats.en: Two hours later, it was finally his turn.
beats.prompt: Inside a dim supermarket with no power, half-empty shelves, daylight from the entrance only, Minsu stepping in with his shopping bag

beats.en: And Minsu grabbed
beats.prompt: Minsu sweeping instant ramen packets off a shelf into his arms, excited, the noodle aisle is the only full shelf

beats.en: ten packs of instant ramen!
beats.prompt: Close-up of Minsu's arms overflowing with a tall stack of colorful instant ramen packets (no text on packets)

beats.en: "That's a whole week of food!"
beats.prompt: Minsu proudly holding his tower of ramen packets, big confident grin, thumbs up

beats.en: Wait!

beats.ko: 라면은 물을 끓여야 하는데, 수도는 끊겼고
beats.en: Ramen needs boiling water. His taps are dry,
and his stove runs on electricity.
beats.prompt: Close-up of a dark, dead induction cooktop in a Korean apartment kitchen with an empty pot on it, Minsu's hand pressing the button with nothing happening

beats.ko: 게다가 라면은 짜서, 목만 더 마르게 해요.
beats.en: And all that salt just makes you thirstier.
beats.prompt: Minsu with his tongue out, very thirsty, sweat drops, holding a ramen packet, wavy heat lines

beats.en: Her basket? Water, canned food, crackers,
beats.prompt: Top-down close-up of the grandma's shopping basket: bottled water, canned food, crackers, a jar of peanut butter, plain labels without text

beats.en: and a manual can opener.
beats.prompt: Close-up of the grandma's wrinkled hand holding up a manual can opener like a treasure, tiny sparkle

beats.ko: 비상식량은 불도 물도 없이, 바로 먹을 수 있는 걸로.
beats.en: Emergency food should be ready to eat. No heat, no water.
beats.prompt: The grandma raising one finger and explaining wisely to Minsu inside the dim supermarket, Minsu listening with ramen in his arms

beats.en: And plan on about a gallon of water per person, per day.
beats.prompt: The grandma holding two large plastic water bottles, one in each hand, firm expression

beats.en: Three days, three gallons. Minsu had zero.
beats.prompt: Minsu counting on his fingers with a shocked face, eyes wide behind his big round glasses, an empty water bottle at his feet

beats.en: And he still had zero cash.
The lady next door slipped him a ten.
beats.prompt: At the supermarket counter, the grandma quietly handing Minsu a folded banknote without looking at him, Minsu teary-eyed and grateful

beats.ko: 민수는 라면을 내려놓고, 물과 통조림을 샀습니다.
beats.en: He put the ramen back, and bought water and cans.
beats.prompt: Minsu walking out of the supermarket carrying a bag with water bottles and cans, the ramen pile left behind on the counter, grandma beside him

beats.en: Minsu's day three survival score:
forty-five out of a hundred.
Tonight, how will he light the dark?
beats.prompt: Split vertical composition, dark apartment at night: left half Minsu holding an unlit candle and a lighter, right half Minsu holding his phone with the flashlight on, empty space at top for big letters

beats.en: A: a candle.
B: the phone flashlight.

beats.ko: 다음 화, DAY 7. 밤이 추워지기 시작합니다.
beats.en: Next time: Day 7. The nights turn cold.

tts.ko: 다음 화, 데이 세븐. 밤이 추워지기 시작합니다.
tts.en: Next time, Day seven. The nights turn cold.

beats.prompt: Night, Minsu wrapped in a thick blanket by a dark window, shivering, visible breath puffs, frost in the window corners
